content.text: A baby shower with the Luxe Coffee Bar, custom cart signage and personalised cup labels to match the chosen colours and theme. The finished setup fit in beautifully with the shower décor.
For this baby shower, the request was simple: a coffee cart with custom signage and cup labels that matched the colours and theme chosen for the day.
We customised the Luxe Coffee Bar to suit, so the finished setup fit in beautifully with the shower décor. Here’s a closer look.
A coffee cart to match the shower
The booking was for the Luxe Coffee Bar on its own, with personalisation for both the cart and cups.
The cart featured a striped front panel, a bow illustration and Café Bébé lettering. Personalised cup labels completed the setup, so guests’ drinks matched the theme too.
With greenery and globe lights above the cart, the custom front panel was easy to see. The coffee menu stood beside it, keeping the counter clear for preparing and serving drinks.
You can see the finished cart and personalised cups in the short film on our homepage.
Thinking about your own baby shower?

If you already have colours or a theme in mind, share them with us when you enquire. Let us know whether you’re interested in custom cart signage, cup labels or both. Not sure what you’d like yet? That’s fine too. We can help you explore the options and find a look that suits your event.
